description: Diagnose and fix React component health issues — unnecessary re-renders, missing keys, stale closures, useEffect misuse, memory leaks, bundle size regressions, and dangerouslySetInnerHTML XSS risks. Use when asked to "React performance audit", "why does this re-render", "React health check", "stale closure", "missing dependency array", "React memory leak", "React XSS", "fix useEffect", "component re-renders too often", "React bundle bloat", or "React anti-patterns". Do NOT use for: full E2E testing — see e2e-testing. Do NOT use for: API design — see api-design.
